If the raw value for a date-valued property is not a string,
warn and discard the value.

If the invalid raw is the only value for the property, as in this test,
discard the property.

-- test.glx --
citations:
  some-citation:
    properties:
      # accessed is a date-valued property and 3 is not a string.
      accessed: 3

-- want-error --
citations\[some-citation\].Properties.accessed: value discarded: expected date string, got int
citations\[some-citation\].Properties.accessed: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
citations\[some-citation\].Properties.accessed: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
citations:
    some-citation:
        properties: {}
